verdict.rationale: Auth0 Organizations lets each business customer have its own branded, federated login flow (i.e., its own SSO connection) and the pricing page lists 'Enterprise Connection', 'Self-Service SSO', and 'SCIM' as organization-related features, supporting multi-tenant SSO setup. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions verified domains or just-in-time (JIT) user provisioning for organizations, so key parts of the story are unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of domain verification per organization, explicit JIT provisioning tied to organization SSO connections, and independent corroboration of these specific sub-features.
